notes.title: 1.02 Update
notes.notes: +Small Bug Fixes (including a bug where the game would crash upon reading the journal during one scene in particular).

notes.title: Version 0.99 is now live! Full release is immenet!
notes.notes:
It's almost ready, everyone. 

Siren's Call: Escape Velocity Version 0.99 is now live. That means all the new music has been added, plus a new music gallery feature that will allow you to listen to all of the game's original music! Other than the translations (which we are still working on for around a April 15th release), the game SHOULD be good to go. We should be leaving early access any day now. 

It's been a long journey and I sincerely appreciate the feedback each and every one of you has provided to help make this game the best it can possibly be. Because of everybody's help and recommendations, we're at a point where I would honestly be comfortable releasing this game. Things feel ready. 

Before we exit early access though, I have a small request. Getting to 50 reviews will put our game in the "Very Positive" bucket when it comes time to release. If you have bought Siren's Call and want to help us have a strong release, please leave a short (or long) review after reading this update. It makes all the difference and creates the opportunity for our studio to continue making more games. Even something as simple as letting people know who your favorite character is can make all the difference in helping us reach that number. It would mean the world to me to have a successful launch, so please, if you like what we're doing here, leave a review!

Just because we'll be launching soon doesn't mean it's too late to make suggestions for the game too! If there are any features you'd like to see that could realistically be added in the future, please let me know. 

Thank you all for helping us get to this point. 

Stay sweet. 
Jacob

notes.title: 0.99v is live now. Full release is imminent.
notes.notes:
+ All of the new music for the game has been added
+ Music Gallery option added to the main menu (does not include stock tracks or ambience)

notes.title: Small Bug Fix + New Content (11/16/2024)
notes.notes:
* Fixed a bug where the developer note didn't load back to the previous scene when read.

* Added the final journal entry to the game (is unlocked after beating the game).

* Various typos and small bugs fixed

notes.title: What sorts of things would you all like to see in the final release?
notes.notes:
Hey there everybody! Lead developer, Jacob here!

I thought it might be fun to open up a discussion of sorts surrounding Escape Velocity! My team and I are always working hard to make sure your stay in Siren's Call is a memorable one and we are all very curious what your experience with the game has been like so far! We would love to hear your thoughts, both here and in the reviews. Is there a particular feature or kind of content you would like to see more of in the game, especially after having finished it? I'm all ears!

notes.title: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity v0.94 update
notes.notes:
+ Fixed bug involving the quick save feature

+ Replaced all the stock tracks in finishing touches 1-8 with original music. Original tracks are now at 36 with more to come.

+ Ported over Sunflower Pie (it's hidden pretty well though)

+ Minor bug fixes and typeos

notes.title: Version 0.93 is live! Every major journal entry now has a scene!
notes.notes:
Like promised, I have made a big update to the game! Siren's Call Escape Velocity has gotten a major update to Oliver's journal! Changes include:

+ Every major journal entry now has its own scene! These scenes will play for the first time after unlocking the entry and can be accessed from the journal at any time!
+ Minor bug fixes and typeo fixes.
+ Demos/early versions for some new songs have been incorporated into the game! Key those ears peeled and you may here something new!

That's all for now! Once we hit 50 reviews, I'll add something even cooler. ;) Until next time everyone, stay sweet!

Yours,
Jacob
